name: Cool Earth
summary: A UK charity that backs Indigenous and local communities in Peru, Papua New Guinea and Cameroon to keep their rainforest standing, mostly with cash given directly to households and community committees, plus data, training and fire prevention.

spending.source: https://opencharities.uk/ew/1117978/files/2026-01-31-accounts.md (trustees' report and audited financial statements for the year ended 31 January 2026, statement of financial activities p. 25: charitable activities £3,270,097 of total expenditure £3,840,396; excludes raising funds £570,299. Pounds converted at $1.3175 a pound, the site's 2025 yearly average (facts/fx.json usd_per_gbp_2025, IRS).)

lines.label: Community forest partnerships (Peru, Papua New Guinea, Cameroon, Go Conscious Earth)
lines.source: https://opencharities.uk/ew/1117978/files/2026-01-31-accounts.md (note 8, p. 35, year ended 31 January 2026): Peru £2,494,400, Papua New Guinea £515,083, Cameroon CCREAD £193,540 and Go Conscious Earth £67,073, with support costs. One line because charityevals models these partnerships as branches of one conservation model. Pounds converted at $1.3175 a pound (facts/fx.json usd_per_gbp_2025, IRS). £3,270,097 = $4,308,353.
